summary: Willis Lease Finance Corporation filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval of a three-for-one forward stock split and an increase in authorized shares. The forward split will be effected via a charter amendment; each share held as of July 6, 2026 record date will become three shares. Trading on a split-adjusted basis is expected to begin July 20, 2026, subject to Nasdaq approval. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation trigger is present.
